name: Crowns
description: Place one crown per row, column, and color region

rules.title: How to Play
rules.rule1: Place exactly one crown in each row
rules.rule2: Place exactly one crown in each column
rules.rule3: Place exactly one crown in each colored region
rules.rule4: Crowns cannot touch each other (including diagonally)

difficultyDescriptions.easy: A 5x5 board — one crown per row, column and region
difficultyDescriptions.medium: A 6x6 board with more regions to reason about
difficultyDescriptions.hard: An 8x8 board and the tightest constraints
